physics_goals.quote: an unambiguous observation would establish a Majorana nature for the neutrino and prove the violation of lepton number
physics_goals.value: Search for neutrinoless double-beta decay of 136Xe using a high-pressure xenon gas TPC with electroluminescence readout

summary.plain: A detector at an underground laboratory in the Spanish Pyrenees that uses high-pressure xenon gas, rather than liquid, to search for a rare radioactive process. Its main detector, NEXT-100, started running in 2024.
summary.technical: NEXT: radiopure high-pressure xenon gas TPC (136Xe-enriched) with electroluminescence (SOFT) readout at LSC, Canfranc, Spain. Original NEXT-100 concept (100 kg Xe) approved in 2012 for 2014 data taking; the smaller NEXT-White prototype ran first, and the full NEXT-100 detector was commissioned in May 2024 and is now taking physics data.

unique_capabilities.quote: NEXT will be the first large high-pressure gas TPC to use electroluminescence readout with SOFT (Separated, Optimized FuncTions) technology.
unique_capabilities.value: High-pressure gaseous (not liquid) xenon TPC with electroluminescence amplification, giving excellent energy resolution and topological background rejection
